targets.name: kissing_5d
targets.title: Kissing Number in 5D
targets.summary: Pack as many non-overlapping unit spheres tangent to a central unit sphere in R^5 as possible (SOTA lower bound: 40).
targets.approach: Submit exact rational points on a sphere |v|^2 = radius_sq in R^5 with 2*dot(u,v) <= radius_sq to maximize sphere count.

targets.name: hadwiger_nelson_plane
targets.title: Hadwiger-Nelson Chromatic Bound
targets.summary: Construct finite unit-distance graphs in Q(sqrt(3), sqrt(11)) with higher proven chromatic number (Moser=4, de Grey=5, open=6).
targets.approach: Construct an exact unit-distance graph over Q(sqrt(3), sqrt(11)) verified non-(k-1)-colorable by exact DSATUR.

targets.name: unit_dist_edges_20
targets.title: Unit-Distance Graph Edges (n <= 20)
targets.summary: Maximize exact unit-distance edges among at most 20 distinct planar points in Q(sqrt(3), sqrt(11)) (Erdos unit-distance problem; max=46).
targets.approach: Pack up to 20 planar points over Q(sqrt(3), sqrt(11)) maximizing exact unit-length pairs |u - v|^2 = 1.
